info.name: Open API, powered by Propertyware Accounting Prospects API

params.name: offset
params.description: `offset` indicates the position of the first record to return. The offset is zero-based and the default is 0.

params.name: limit
params.description: `limit` indicates the maximum number of results to be returned in the response. `limit` can range between 1 and 500 and the default is 100.

params.name: lastModifiedDateTimeStart
params.description: Filters results to any item modified on or after the date time specified.

params.name: lastModifiedDateTimeEnd
params.description: Filters results to any item modified on or prior to the date time specified.

params.name: orderby
params.description: Indicates the field(s) and direction to sort the results in the response.

params.name: status
params.description: Filters results to prospects with a specific status.

params.name: portfolioID
params.description: Filters results to prospects associated with a specific portfolio.

params.name: buildingID
params.description: Filters results to prospects associated with a specific building.

params.name: type
params.description: Filters results to prospects with a specific type.

params.name: includeCustomFields
params.description: includeCustomFields
